prompts.title: Viral Photo Collage Prompt Instagram
prompts.prompt:
Use my reference photograph as the ONLY identity reference. Recreate the composition of the model image exactly, replacing the original woman with me in every appearance.
EXTREME IDENTITY LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY
Preserve my exact same face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, smile, facial shape, natural skin tone and texture, apparent age, ethnicity, hair, hair color, and body proportions. I must look like the same real person in every frame, without changing my identity, making me look younger, making me slimmer, or creating a generic AI face.
Create a vertical, cheerful, super-realistic photographic collage on a smooth warm beige wall. Place approximately seven vintage rectangular frames made of rustic, weathered wood, overlapping and arranged dynamically. My body must interact naturally with the frames, creating a convincing three-dimensional effect.
At the top center, show me full-body, casually sitting on several frames, with one leg bent and the other extending downward in front of them. I am smiling at the camera and raising one hand in a peace sign. I wear a fitted petrol-blue T-shirt, straight-leg blue jeans, and clean white sneakers.
Inside the other frames, show repeated versions of me with the exact same face and outfit, performing different expressions and gestures:
• Laughing with my eyes closed.
• Looking surprised with both hands on my cheeks.
• Making a heart shape with my hands.
• Taking a selfie with a phone.
• Hands on my cheeks with an excited smile.
• Raising both hands in celebration.
Decorate the empty spaces with hand-drawn doodle-style illustrations: red hearts, yellow stars, a small crown, excitement lines, and speech bubbles containing the following large, perfectly legible phrases according to subject mood:
“BEST DAY EVER!”
“OOPS!”
“SO HAPPY!”
“HAHA!”
“LOVE THIS!”
“LITTLE MOMENTS!”
Add three vintage cameras placed decoratively around the collage.
Photography: hyper-realistic editorial photography, warm and even studio lighting, soft natural shadows behind the frames, clearly visible wood texture, convincing three-dimensional depth, realistic skin texture, anatomically correct hands, sharp focus, clean colors, youthful, spontaneous and playful atmosphere, ultra-high detail, 8K quality, vertical 2:3 composition.
NEGATIVE PROMPT
Different face between frames, multiple identities, altered facial features, rejuvenated appearance, modified body, plastic skin, deformed faces, incorrect hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, floating frames, body passing through objects, illegible text, misspelled letters, low resolution, blur, excessive yellow lighting, cartoon style, artificial appearance, generic AI face, inconsistent hairstyle, inconsistent clothing, distorted anatomy, unnatural poses.

prompts.title: Good Days and Doodle Skies
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8K ultra-high-resolution, hyper-realistic lifestyle portrait of a couple sitting side by side on the white roof of a vintage teal camper van, set against a clear, vivid deep-blue sky. Maintain accurate identity and precise facial likeness to the provided reference image(s) for both subjects.
Subjects & Pose: The man sits on the left, wearing a relaxed white linen button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, loose beige trousers, and grey canvas sneakers. He is turned slightly toward the woman, looking at her with a soft, affectionate smile. The woman sits on the right, wearing a light, airy white spaghetti-strap sundress paired with white sneakers. She is laughing naturally, looking forward with a joyful expression. She holds a small yellow daisy delicately in one hand and a cluster of pastel balloons (soft blue, pale yellow, and white) in the other. Both subjects sit casually with their legs dangling over the edges of the van's windows, conveying a relaxed, carefree mood.
Environment & Background: The background is a clean, open sky in a vivid deep-blue tone with no clutter. The lower foreground features slightly blurred wildflowers (white daisies and green stems) to add depth and a natural springtime feel. The teal camper van has a vintage aesthetic, with visible window framing and subtle reflections.
Graphic Overlay Style: Overlay the scene with playful, hand-drawn doodles in a soft pastel palette (white, yellow, pink, and light blue), including simple flowers, smiling faces, stars, hearts, clouds, sparkles, and motion lines around the couple and balloons. Add handwritten-style white text floating in the sky reading: "good days," "stay close," and "happy place." The typography should feel casual, light, and whimsical — like chalk or marker doodles.
Lighting & Mood: Bright, soft natural daylight (midday to early afternoon), evenly lit with minimal harsh shadows. The overall mood is warm, romantic, cheerful, and carefree, evoking a dreamy spring/summer vibe, while the color grading stays cool/neutral rather than warm-toned. 
Composition & Camera: Vertical framing (3:4 aspect ratio), eye-level perspective aligned with the van roof. Subjects are placed slightly below center, leaving ample negative space above for the text and doodles. Balanced composition with the couple as the focal point.
Technical Details: Shot on a professional DSLR, 85mm lens, f/2.8 aperture for shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed textures, crisp focus on the subjects, soft background blur, 8K resolution, neutral/cool color tone (not warm).

prompts.title: Trending Doodle Shadow
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the reference character’s face identity, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, visible accessories, overall recognizable vibe, outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.
For each generation, invent a new playful mischievous pose for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making a big heart pose
- cheeky wink pose
- hands near cheeks in a cute teasing pose
- exaggerated “that's it!” pose
- mock surprise pose
- playful running-in-place pose
- mischievous tiptoe pose
- arms stretched in opposite directions
- pretending to sneak away
- cute troublemaker pose
- dramatic overreaction pose
- goofy victory pose
- playful balance pose
- playful peekaboo pose
- shy but mischievous pose
- cute overconfident pose

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.
The real person should look like they are reluctantly playing along.
The doodle-shadow should look like it is having way too much fun.

Composition:
- vertical 3:4 or 2:3
- show the real person in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- place the real person on one side of the frame
- place the black doodle-shadow on a clean wall beside them
- the doodle-shadow should be roughly the same height or slightly taller
- keep enough space around both figures so the full pose is visible
- the connection between the real person and the doodle-shadow must be clear at a glance

Background:
- simple clean indoor studio wall or minimal room corner
- white, cream, or pale gray wall
- clean floor
- soft natural sunlight patch or gentle wall shadow allowed
- keep the background uncluttered

Lighting:
- soft natural studio lighting
- bright, clean, polished, playful mood
- keep the real person’s face clearly visible

Style quality:
- realistic human photography
- black hand-drawn doodle-shadow on wall
- matching mischievous pose interaction
- strong identity resemblance
- outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference
- cute and stylish mixed-media portrait
- clean composition
- social-media-friendly
- no obvious AI artifacts

Negative prompt:
Outfit change unrelated to reference, realistic second person, normal reflection, normal shadow only, solid black monster shadow, horror shadow, creepy shadow, full-color illustration, cartoon human, anime human, weak resemblance, unrelated sketch character, messy wall, cluttered background, repeated pointing pose, repeated finger-gun pose, same pose every time, fixed pose, boring mirrored pose, stiff pose, identical pose repetition, real person not matching shadow pose, text, watermark, logo, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands.

Relaxed yet confident seated pose. One arm (right arm) is resting comfortably over the backrest of the chair, with the hand hanging naturally, while the other arm rests loosely on his thigh.

Ultra-sharp focus, cinematic contrast, editorial fashion aesthetic, 8K resolution, high detail retention, clean monochrome subject with vibrant graphic highlights.
